dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly concave trailing edge following a parabolic spline from the posterior base to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a moderate pixel radius at the highest point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 50 degrees relative to the horizontal longitudinal axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate ratio of 1.15:1 (base width to vertical height).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Diffuse light-colored speckling on the mid-lateral surface of the fin; trailing edge lacks definitive notches or trauma-induced indentations.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced horizontal color gradient transitioning from a dark grey distal section to a significantly lighter grey proximal base.
